title: Details to Follow

mood.label: Uneasy
mood.summary: A surprise energy ceasefire for Ukraine nudged oil down and markets up, but Moscow hadn't confirmed. The Gulf stayed heavy, North Korea fired missiles, Sudan and Congo suffered, a Category 4 hurricane churned — with small light from Brazil's freed children and lab progress.

lines: Monday rang with a ceasefire nobody planned,
Kyiv said yes, then asked for terms.
Moscow kept quiet, the oil price dipped,
Brent still hovering where it burns.
Riyadh's runway took the second hit,
missiles from the north fell into the sea.
Miners in Sudan, a fever moving east,
Simon turning on the Pacific's knee.
Details to follow, guarantees to come,
hold the good news loosely in your hand.
Thirteen children walking out in Brazil —
some days that's the only thing that stands.
